“Whatever the heck this is, it’s sexy.”

That first pang of love in one’s heart is ever a sudden thing. That fiery passion I had felt towards my first love as a child, Yuunagi Shizuku, was revitalized as I was suddenly thrust into a vivid erotic fantasy centering around her. And the reason I came back to the city from my childhood only to be suddenly assailed by erotic fantasies about my first love…?

item.title: Sorakoi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ChelseaSoft
  • 発売日: 2015-12-18
  • スコア: 7.15/10 (70 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ソラコイ
  • 英語名: Sorakoi

あらすじ

This is the first title by Chelseasoft, a sister brand of MORE. Hikari and Takuto were born on the same day and have been together ever since. Learning how to crawl, graduating from diapers, running their first errands, riding a bike… they were always together every step of the way. That’s what it means to be childhood friends after all. They went to the same Kinomori Gakuen and joined the movie research club. They believed that they would always be close childhood friends forever.
